summary: Comprehensive testing of StageHand teleprompter auto-scroll and song link features. All features working correctly after main agent's fix using requestAnimationFrame with time-based accumulator.
passed_tests: Auto-scroll functionality - scrolls lyrics based on song duration (13.67 px/sec at 100% speed)
Speed slider control - 300% speed scrolls at ~41.33 px/sec (3x faster than 100%)
Auto-scroll toggle - disabling stops scrolling, re-enabling resumes
Song navigation - skip to specific song buttons work
Display modes - Default, High Contrast, Stage Red, Daylight all working
Font size settings - Small, Medium, Large, X-Large all working
Song Link feature - PLAY button appears for songs with links in SetListEditor
Song Link input - Practice Link field visible and editable in SongEditor
Backend API - 12/12 tests passed (Songs CRUD, SetLists CRUD, Link feature)
Duration parsing - MM:SS format correctly parsed for auto-scroll calculation
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-scroll implementation using requestAnimationFrame with time-based accumulator is correct and efficient
Speed slider properly affects scroll rate (verified 3x difference between 100% and 300%)
Song duration parsing handles MM:SS format correctly
Console logging provides good debugging info for auto-scroll (shows duration, speed, px/sec)
seed_data_creation: Test songs created and cleaned up during pytest run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-scroll feature was previously broken for many iterations. Main agent fixed it by using requestAnimationFrame with a time-based accumulator that only scrolls when >= 1px accumulated. Test setlist ID: 7b8f84ab-80d8-4494-be8d-7ab561f51168. Song 'The Remainder' (ID: 64b4f1d3-5fa2-4e46-9f13-616aa14450bd) has a practice link set. Speed slider requires using native input value setter to trigger React state update in Playwright tests.
